about_the_game:
A family curse. A deadly heirloom. A race against time.

Welcome to the world of Hidden Legacy: Dark Heirloom — a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game. This is a story-rich, point-and-click adventure where you'll explore beautifully crafted scenes, search for cleverly hidden objects, and solve a variety of challenging puzzles. It's a perfect mix of mystery, logic, and visual exploration — ideal for players who enjoy immersive storytelling and clever gameplay!

The tale follows renowned genealogist Gabriel Vanyard, who is drawn into the chilling mystery of the Montgomery family. Their legacy is tied to a cursed ring that brings death to its bearer. From the moss-covered ruins of an Irish estate to the majestic Scottish Highlands and bustling streets of London, Gabriel must uncover the truth and break the curse before it claims the last heir. What secrets lie within the Montgomery bloodline — and can they be unraveled in time?

Enjoy a thrilling range of gameplay experiences: search for hidden objects across eerie and enchanting scenes, challenge your logic with creative mini-games, and test your focus with brain-teasing puzzles. Each scene offers a fresh opportunity to prove your detective skills!

This Collector's Edition includes:

👁️ Hidden Object scenes across multiple hauntingly atmospheric locations!

👁️ Travel through gripping environments: crumbling estates, shadowy ruins, and more!

👁️ Discover and collect dozens of hidden items and special collectibles!

👁️ Dozens of tricky puzzles and relaxing mini-games!

👁️ Unlock achievements that reveal deeper layers of the story!

👁️ Dive into the immersive soundtrack, stunning wallpapers, and rich atmosphere!

Step into the shadows of the past — the hidden legacy awaits. Uncover a deadly family secret in this haunting adventure!
